title.zh: 在达沃市Toril区Alambre描笼涯设立国立中学，名称为Alambre国立农业中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Alambre, Toril District, Davao City to be Known as Alambre National Agricultural High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Alambre, Toril District, Davao City to be Known as Alambre National Agricultural High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11423_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Alambre, Toril District, Davag City to be known as Alambre National Agricultural High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Alambre National Agricultural High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
